title: An Ado About Nigeria’s Dairy Business
summary: Nigeria has millions of cows and millions of milk drinkers, but we still buy most of our milk and butter from other countries. Here is why that makes no sense, and how we can fix it.

title: Livestock: The Nigerian Context
summary: Breaking down the big picture: how many animals we have, what meat actually costs, where diseases strike, and why banks are afraid to lend money to farmers.

title: Why Farmers Should Adopt Technology for Day-to-Day Record Keeping
summary: If you don't track what you spend on feed and medicine, you can sell a cow for a lot of cash and still lose money. Simple records turn guessing games into real profits.

title: Another Outlook on the Farmer–Herder Conflict
summary: Building walls between farmers and herders will never work. The real fix is trade: when both sides do business together, share resources, and make money, peace follows.

title: The Future of Livestock Farming Is Smarter Systems
summary: Farming by gut feeling only gets you so far. Simple tracking tools and honest math are how modern farms stay afloat and actually grow.

title: What Value Do Leaders Bring to Organizations in the AI Era?
summary: AI can write code, crunch spreadsheets, and draft reports in seconds. So what are human leaders actually here for? The answers that machines can't copy.
